bundle.shortDescription: AWS CloudTrail log analyzer for blue team investigations
bundle.longDescription: TrailInspector is an offline desktop tool for analyzing AWS CloudTrail logs. Load exported .json.gz or ZIP archives, search with SPL-like syntax, and surface MITRE ATT&CK-mapped detections — no AWS credentials required.
